```{r}
cdc_data <- read_csv("index_scores_v3_2026.csv", 
                     show_col_types = FALSE,
                     na = c("", "NA", "NULL", "N/A", "?", "-")) |>
  clean_names() 
```

```{r}
plot_missing(cdc_data)
```

```{r}
numeric_vars <- cdc_data %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

for (var in names(numeric_vars)) {
  boxplot(numeric_vars[[var]],
          main = var,
          xlab = "")
}
```
```{r}
composite_scores = c("economic", "education", "housing", "health", "crime")

ca_df <- cdc_data %>% 
  filter(state == "CA") %>%
  group_by(county) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(composite_scores),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "avg_{.col}"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
df_split <- initial_split(ca_df, prop = 0.60, strata = avg_education)
df_train <- training(df_split)
df_test  <- testing(df_split)

cat("Training rows:", nrow(df_train), "| Test rows:", nrow(df_test))
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
df_folds <- vfold_cv(df_train, v = 10, strata = avg_education)
df_folds
```

```{r}
shared_rec <- recipe(avg_education ~ ., data = df_train) |>
  update_role(county, new_role = "ID") %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |>                     # Remove zero-variance predictors
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) |>   # Impute numeric NAs with median
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>     # Impute factor NAs with mode
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) # One-hot encode factors
```

```{r}
reg_metrics <- metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq, mape)
reg_metrics
```

```{r}
rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  mode  = "regression",
  trees = tune(),
  mtry  = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("ranger",
             importance = "permutation",
             seed       = 123)

rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(shared_rec) |>
  add_model(rf_spec)
set.seed(123)

# Count predictors after recipe baking for mtry range
n_preds <- ncol(bake(prep(shared_rec, df_train), new_data = NULL)) - 1

rf_grid <- grid_latin_hypercube(
  trees(range = c(700L, 1500L)),
  mtry(range  = c(1L, 4L)),
  min_n(range = c(3L, 10L)),
  size = 25
)

rf_tune <- tune_grid(
  rf_wf,
  resamples = df_folds,
  grid      = rf_grid,
  metrics   = reg_metrics,
  control   = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
)

autoplot(rf_tune)
```

```{r}
rf_best      <- select_best(rf_tune, metric = "rmse")
final_rf_wf  <- finalize_workflow(rf_wf, rf_best)
final_rf_fit <- fit(final_rf_wf, data = df_train)

rf_best
```

```{r}
rf_test_preds <- predict(final_rf_fit, df_test) |>
  bind_cols(df_test |> select(avg_education))

rf_test_preds |> reg_metrics(truth = avg_education, estimate = .pred)
```

```{r}
rf_vi <- vip::vi(extract_fit_engine(final_rf_fit)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  mutate(
    pct   = 100 * Importance / sum(Importance),
    Model = "Random Forest"
  ) |>
  rename(Variable = Variable)

ggplot(rf_vi, aes(x = reorder(Variable, pct), y = pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#377EB8") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "avg_economic" = "Economic Composite Score",
    "avg_health" = "Health Composite Score",
    "avg_crime" = "Crime Composite Score",
    "avg_housing" = "Housing Composite Score"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest — Variable Importance",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Importance (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
rf_engine <- extract_fit_engine(final_rf_fit2)

leaf_counts <- sapply(1:rf_engine$num.trees, function(i) {
  tree <- ranger::treeInfo(rf_engine, tree = i)
  sum(tree$terminal)
})

summary(leaf_counts)
mean(leaf_counts)
```



```{r}

    avg_education = mean(education, na.rm = TRUE),
    unemployment = mean(unemployment, na.rm = TRUE),
    poverty = mean(poverty, na.rm = TRUE),
    access_to_broadband_internet = mean(access_to_broadband_internet, na.rm = TRUE),
    single_parent_households = mean(single_parent_households, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}

```

```{r}

  update_role(county, new_role = "ID") %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |>                     # Remove zero-variance predictors
  step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors()) |>   # Impute numeric NAs with median
  step_impute_mode(all_nominal_predictors()) |>     # Impute factor NAs with mode
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE) # One-hot encode factors
```

```{r}

```

```{r}

  mode  = "regression",
  trees = tune(),
  mtry  = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) |>
  set_engine("ranger",
             importance = "permutation",

  trees(range = c(300L, 1000L)),
```

```{r}
highschool_df <- cdc_data %>%
  group_by(state) %>%
  filter(state != "PR") %>%
  summarise(avg_less_than_hs = mean(less_than_hs, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_less_than_hs,n=10) 

ggplot(highschool_df,aes(x = state, y = avg_less_than_hs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#377EB8") +
  labs(
    title = "Highest Average Percentage of Population with Less Than High School Education",
    x = "State",
    y = "Average Percentage Less Than High School (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
